title: How to book an appointment
content: You can book an appointment through the app, website, or by phone. Choose a service type, pick an available date and time, and confirm with your name and phone number.

title: How to reschedule an appointment
content: To reschedule, provide the name on the booking and your preferred new date and time — we recommend rescheduling at least 2 hours before your original slot.

title: How to cancel an appointment
content: Appointments can be cancelled from the app, website, or by phone up until the scheduled time, with no cancellation fee.

title: Vaccination appointments
content: Vaccination appointments are available for flu, COVID-19, and other routine immunizations. Most take about 15 minutes including a required post-shot observation period.

title: Pharmacist consultation appointments
content: You can book a one-on-one consultation with a pharmacist to discuss medications, potential interactions, or general health questions in a private setting.

title: Walk-in versus scheduled appointments
content: Some services accept walk-ins, but scheduling in advance is recommended to reduce wait time, especially for vaccinations during peak season.

title: Appointment reminders
content: You'll receive an automatic reminder by text or email 24 hours before your appointment, with an option to confirm, reschedule, or cancel directly from the reminder.

title: Late arrival policy
content: If you arrive more than 10 minutes late, your appointment may need to be rescheduled depending on availability that day.

title: No-show policy
content: Missed appointments without cancellation are marked as no-shows. Repeated no-shows may require phone confirmation for future bookings.

title: How appointments are confirmed
content: Every booking is confirmed immediately by text or email with the date, time, location, and service type.

title: Documents needed for an appointment
content: Bring a photo ID and your insurance card if applicable. For prescription-related consultations, bring your prescription number or medication list.

title: Appointments for minors
content: Appointments for anyone under 18 require a parent or legal guardian to be present and to provide consent at the time of the visit.

title: Telehealth appointment option
content: Select consultation services are available by video call for customers who can't visit in person. A stable internet connection and the app are required.

title: Typical appointment duration
content: Most consultations run 15 to 20 minutes, and vaccination appointments run about 15 minutes including observation time.

title: Booking for multiple family members
content: You can book back-to-back appointments for family members in one session by adding each person's name and date of birth during checkout.

title: Appointment fees
content: Most vaccination and consultation appointments are covered by insurance with no out-of-pocket cost; self-pay pricing is shown before you confirm the booking.

title: Using insurance for appointments
content: Add your insurance information when booking, and we'll verify coverage ahead of your visit — you'll be notified in advance of any expected co-pay.

title: Holiday scheduling availability
content: Appointment availability is reduced on major holidays; check the booking calendar for open slots or call your local store to confirm hours.
